method: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1) on whether the corrected level-1 answer equals the MN-DS gold level-1 code; fitted on publisher-held-out out-of-fold predictions of MN-DS train only
fit_set: MN-DS train publishers only (4103 items, 144 publishers), 5 publisher folds
line_rule: same as landing_calibrate.find_line: lowest floor(1000 p) whose set of 30+ items has accuracy >= 0.80 (on the out-of-fold items); decision ANSWER_L1 iff floor(1000 p) >= line_permille

dev_select.note: select is the dev half; never used to fit
